# Orca runtime (Orca)

Orca's runtime is an [agent host][industry.agent-host]: it runs Claude Code, Codex and other harnesses in its worktrees and owns their sessions. It lives inside the Orca app, and `orca serve` runs it headless on a machine with no screen ([OR1]).
